items.t: Said he will work with President Trump to right-size the previous administration's fiscal policies.
items.q: Rep. Bergman will continue to work with President Trump to right-size the previous administration's disastrous fiscal policies that were crushing Americans livelihoods and way of life.

items.t: Returned to the House Budget Committee in 2023 and chairs its Oversight Task Force.
items.q: In 2023, Rep. Bergman returned as a Member of the House Budget Committee, after serving on the Committee during his First term in Congress.

items.t: Wants to create a responsible federal budget and rein in government spending.
items.q: Creating a responsible federal budget and reining in our Government's out-of-control spending habits are a passion of the Congressman.

items.t: Says the military must remain the strongest and most lethal force in the world.
items.q: As new threats emerge, our military must remain the strongest and most lethal force in the world.

items.t: Says accountability and oversight are paramount to ensure defense spending is maximized to protect the nation and its allies.
items.q: Accountability and oversight are paramount as we work to ensure every dollar spent on defense is maximized to best protect our Nation and our allies.

items.t: Serves as a member of the House Armed Services Committee.
items.q: Congressman Bergman proudly serves as a member of the House Armed Services Committee.

items.t: Says he will continue defending the United States from those who want to weaken it, domestically and abroad.
items.q: He is shaking up the status quo in both Congress and will continue defending the United States from those who want to weaken it, both domestically and abroad.

items.t: Serves on the House Committee on Veterans' Affairs, including its Oversight and Investigations and Health Subcommittees.
items.q: Congressman Bergman serves on both the Oversight and Investigations Subcommittee and the Health Subcommittee.

items.t: Has pushed for accountability from within the VA and held field hearings and round-table discussions in Michigan's First District.
items.q: he has championed groundbreaking Veterans’ legislation, held multiple field hearings and round-table discussions in Michigan's First District, and pushed for accountability from within VA.
